description: League quality tiers + season-start month for the meta-learning layer. ADDITIVE: leagueProfiles.config.json owns model priors (goal/draw/card frequencies) and is never modified by this layer. Override via META_LEAGUE_TIERS_JSON or META_LEAGUE_TIERS_PATH. seasonStartMonth (1-12) exists because BacktestAnalytics.seasonStartIso() hardcodes August, which is wrong for calendar-year competitions such as MLS - season-phase buckets would otherwise be meaningless for them. Only league ids already present in leagueProfiles.config.json are seeded here; every other league falls through to `default`. Tier assignment is an editorial judgement about which competitions are comparable, not a technical fact.
